name: 01867 · Reading, MA
findings: ZIP 01867 (Reading) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01867 (Reading) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
